editorial.editors_note: While our industry seems content to bury its fading architectural integrity under layers of automated bloat, the lone engineer working in C reminds us that the machine still has a basement where the ghosts are occasionally required to speak for themselves.
editorial.emphasis: The tension between individual craft and the automated erosion of developer agency.

top_candidates.generated_headline: IBM’s Granite 4.1 tests the limits of architectural efficiency
